enable1.txt.title: ENABLE (172k words)
enable1.txt.description: Expansive public-domain game list. The broad default: almost anything reasonable plays, including obscure vocabulary.

tournament_american.txt.title: Tournament American (24k words)
tournament_american.txt.description: Curated 6of12 list. Clean everyday vocabulary, but fewer inflections than the expansive list.

extended_american.txt.title: Extended American (75k words)
extended_american.txt.description: 2of12inf with inflections. A balanced middle ground between tournament and expansive play.

international_game.txt.title: International Game (61k words)
international_game.txt.description: Internationally oriented 12dicts game vocabulary. Accepts some words American players may contest.

arcane_lexicon.txt.title: Arcane Lexicon (145 words)
arcane_lexicon.txt.description: Bonus word file: fantasy flavor words. Playing them triggers an Arcane Surge (+25 each). Pros: thematic spice when merged. Cons: far too small alone.

common_english.txt.title: Common English (2.1k words)
common_english.txt.description: Casual/family mode: small everyday vocabulary, playable entirely on its own for relaxed games. Foundation of the two-letter whitelist. Off by default - enable alongside big grimoires only for flavor.

acronyms.txt.title: Acronyms & Initialisms
acronyms.txt.description: Opt-in abbreviations that can be spoken or spelled as letters (NASA, GIF, HTML, TLDR). Fun, modern, and intentionally nontraditional.

pirate_pillage.txt.title: Pirate Pillage (55 words)
pirate_pillage.txt.description: Bonus file: swashbuckling vocabulary. Playing these words triggers a surge (+25 each). Yo ho.

medieval_might.txt.title: Medieval Might (50 words)
medieval_might.txt.description: Bonus file: knights, sieges and heraldry. Playing these words triggers a surge (+25 each).

gothic_grimoire.txt.title: Gothic Grimoire (47 words)
gothic_grimoire.txt.description: Bonus file: haunted horror vocabulary. Playing these words triggers a surge (+30 each). Best played by candlelight.

cosmic_canticle.txt.title: Cosmic Canticle (31 words)
cosmic_canticle.txt.description: Bonus file: starfaring vocabulary. Rarer words, richer reward (+40 each).

kitchen_witchery.txt.title: Kitchen Witchery (31 words)
kitchen_witchery.txt.description: Bonus file: hearth-craft and cookery. Gentle surges (+15 each). Cozy mode.

prairie_homestead.txt.title: Prairie Homestead (60 words)
prairie_homestead.txt.description: Bonus file: frontier homecraft, prairie life and handwork. Playing these words triggers a warm surge (+20 each).

velvet_leather.txt.title: Velvet & Leather (58 words)
velvet_leather.txt.description: Bonus file: consensual-adult kink vocabulary and luxurious materials. Playing these words triggers a velvet surge (+25 each).

two_letter_whitelist.txt.title: Two-Letter Whitelist
two_letter_whitelist.txt.description: Trusted two-letter words used by the strict two-letter rule. Not playable on its own.

profanity_blacklist.txt.title: Profanity Filter
profanity_blacklist.txt.description: Project-curated profanity and coarse-language policy list. Hidden from grimoire selection.

slur_blacklist.txt.title: Slur Filter
slur_blacklist.txt.description: Small, conservative table-rules exclusion list. Reclaimed and context-sensitive language is deliberately handled cautiously.

given_names.txt.title: Given Names (SSA sampler)
given_names.txt.description: Opt-in given names sampled across eras from published U.S. Social Security popularity data. Names are facts; overlaps with ordinary words are expected.

proper_nouns_reference.txt.title: Proper Nouns Reference
proper_nouns_reference.txt.description: Non-exhaustive places, celestial objects, and historical names for optional table-rule enforcement. Not a playable grimoire.

brands_trademarks.txt.title: Brands & Trademarks Reference
brands_trademarks.txt.description: Non-exhaustive reference list of brand, product, and trademark terms for optional table rules. Inclusion does not assert current registration or ownership.

african_american_english.txt.title: African American English (starter)
african_american_english.txt.description: A deliberately modest opt-in sampler of documented AAE lexicalized forms. AAE is a diverse, systematic language variety whose grammar cannot be represented by a word list.

tech_jargon.txt.title: Technology Jargon
tech_jargon.txt.description: Opt-in computing, networking, and software vocabulary. Useful with smaller base grimoires and gloriously argumentative at a traditional word-game table.

science_jargon.txt.title: Science Jargon
science_jargon.txt.description: Opt-in vocabulary from biology, chemistry, physics, and laboratory practice.

spanish_starter.txt.title: Spanish (starter)
spanish_starter.txt.description: Common Spanish words that can be represented with the current A-Z tile set. Words requiring accents or Ñ are mostly deferred until multilingual tiles arrive.

french_starter.txt.title: French (starter)
french_starter.txt.description: Common French words compatible with the current A-Z tiles, including conventional OE spellings. Accent-dependent words are deferred.

italian_starter.txt.title: Italian (starter)
italian_starter.txt.description: Common Italian vocabulary. The present board uses ASCII folding where a spelling normally carries an accent; native tile support is planned.
